d: Bihar Air Pollution: : dilli ki hava ki tarah ab bihar ki hava bhi jahrili ho gaee hai.... kya dilli ke bad ab patna ke logon ki bhi sanson par sankat mandrane laga hai.... kya bihar ke logon ko bhi ab jahrili hava men sans lene ki majburi hogi.... aakhir divali ki aatishbaji ke bad bihar ke shahron ka aisa bura hal kyon ho gaya hai...aur sabse bara saval.... kya iske pichhe sirph patakhon ka dhuaan hai ya pradushan barhne ki kuchh aur vajhen bhi hain...lekin is puri kahani men sabse chaunkane vala aankra kis shahar ka hai... kis shahar ki hava sabse jyada jahrili ho chuki hai...aur aakhir…
